title: WorkOrderPackage
description: The complete dispatch unit handed to an execution agent: spec reference, scope allowlist, acceptance predicates, budget slice, and the prompt. allowed_files and forbidden_files are path glob arrays — a work order without both lists is unscoped and MUST be rejected by the execution harness. acceptance_predicates are machine-verifiable PASS/FAIL judgements (subjective opinions go to risk_findings in the merge dossier, never here). provenance_requirement drives whether a full chain tape is mandatory or whether partial + human confirmation suffices.
